imported.leave: Don't want to be here? You can leave the Kehila in Me.

terms.title: The Kehila terms are waiting
terms.body: {kehila}'s management screens open once one gabbai accepts the terms. Everything else works as usual.

seatLink.title: Your seats in the synagogue
seatLink.bodyOne: A gabbai connected one seat to your account. You can now tell us here if you're coming on Shabbat.
seatLink.bodyOther: A gabbai connected {n} seats to your account. You can now tell us here if you're coming on Shabbat.

tech.title: The tech linked you as a family

age13.title: One moment before you continue
age13.body: Kehilot is for people aged 13 and over. Confirm your age to continue.
age13.underBody: Sorry, the app is for people aged 13 and over. You can delete your account now, or sign out and come back when you're 13.

terms.title: Terms between the Kehila and Kehilot
terms.intro: Before managing {kehila}, one gabbai accepts these terms. Your acceptance covers the whole Kehila.
terms.p1: The Kehila is responsible for its members' data. Kehilot runs the service for it and uses the data only for that.
terms.p2: Data is stored encrypted on AWS servers in Israel, and everyone sees only what their role allows.
terms.p3: Sub-processors: AWS (servers and storage), Expo (notifications, generic text only), Google and Apple (sign-in, for those who use them).
terms.p4: When the Kehila stops using the service, its data is deleted.
terms.accept: Accept the terms for the Kehila
terms.others: Everything else in the app, including the phone list, keeps working without it.

kehilaInfo.roles: The Kehila is responsible for its members' data. The Kehilot platform runs the service.
kehilaInfo.terms: Terms between the Kehila and Kehilot

push.familyGabbai: Your family details were updated by the management team

testBuild.title: New test version
testBuild.body: Version {version} is ready. The download opens in your browser, then Android installs it over this version.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.intro: What happened, and what did you expect? Your report goes to the development team only, not to the gabbaim.
bug.picNote: Check it shows nothing you'd rather not send.
bug.autoNot: Not sent: message content, passwords or other people's details.
bug.signedOut: Without an account you can send text only.
bug.discard: Close without sending? What you wrote will be lost.
bug.error: The report wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again. What you wrote is kept.
bug.limitUser: You've sent a lot of reports today. You can send again tomorrow.
bug.limitAnon: Many reports came from this network. Try again in an hour.
bug.tooBig: The picture is too large. Try another one or send without it.
bug.limitUpload: Many pictures were sent this hour. Try again in an hour or send without a picture.

row.byGabbai: A gabbai updated it · You can change it until {day} {time}
row.none: No seats for you this Shabbat. Ask a gabbai if you have questions.

seats.zoom: Pinch to zoom in and out.
seats.split: Your seats are in two places in the hall.
seats.closed: Updates closed {day} {time}. To change, ask a gabbai.
seats.byGabbai: Your seats were updated by the gabbaim. You can change them until the deadline.
seats.noneBody: Seats are allocated by the gabbai. For questions, ask a gabbai.
seats.discardBody: You marked seats and did not save.

print.title: Print the hall map
print.namesNote: Prints are sometimes posted in the hall. Without names it shows only each seat's state.
print.phoneSoon: Printing a PDF from the phone is coming soon.
print.styleNote: Remembered on this device. The shapes stay in every style, even on a black-and-white printer.

print.emptyBody: To print, first set up the seat map: paste the chart you already have, or build the hall from scratch.
print.legendPending: Pending · no answer, kept for them

seats.updatedNow: Your seats changed in the meantime. This is the current state.

behalf.title: Update for a household
behalf.sub: For a household that answered a gabbai, not the app.
behalf.none: No households have seats on the map yet.
behalf.note: Recorded as "updated by a gabbai". The household sees "A gabbai updated", without a name.
behalf.stale: Someone updated this household meanwhile. This is the latest state; check and save again.
behalf.pastDeadline: Updates are closed. A gabbai can still update.
behalf.tapHint: Or tap one of the household's seats on the map.
behalf.noteTech: It will read "Updated by a tech". The family will see "The tech updated", with no name.

schedule.title: Prayer times
schedule.updated: Times are for {city}. Updated by the gabbaim on {date}.
schedule.printError: We couldn't prepare the file for printing.
schedule.offline: Prayer times saved on this device at {time}. There may be an update.
schedule.empty: The Kehila hasn't set up its prayer times yet.

editor.title: Prayer times
editor.shareNotice: The pinned notice as a separate image
editor.rowNotePlaceholder: e.g. in the small study hall
editor.timeHint: Type 830, 8:30 or 08:30. The arrow keys add 5 minutes.
editor.fixedSummary: Fixed time, the same every week.
editor.isCandlesNote: Shown on its own line on Home, and never as the next prayer.
editor.cannotCompute: This time can't be calculated for this week.
editor.weekOnlyNote: The formula stays for other weeks.
editor.weekOnlyLocked: A change for one week can only be made for the coming Shabbat and the week after.
editor.weekHidden: The row won't show this week and comes back next week.
editor.weekUsually: Usually: {time}. Back to normal next week.
editor.warnAfterSunset: {row} comes out at {time}, and sunset on {day} is {sunset}. Did you mean "down"?
editor.warnLateCandles: Rounding moves it later, to {time} (instead of {exact}).
editor.warnBoundsCross: "Not before {earliest}" is later than "not after {latest}". "Not after" wins.
editor.warnBoundWins: The formula has no effect on the result, because one of the bounds decides every day.
editor.keys: Esc closes · Enter opens a row · Alt+↑↓ moves · Ctrl+S saves · Ctrl+Z undoes
editor.deleteSectionAsk: Delete the section and its {n} rows?
editor.rowCountWeekday: {n} rows · one time for the whole week
editor.sectionEmpty: No rows in this section yet.
editor.emptyBody: You can start from a ready structure: Shabbat and weekdays with the usual rows, and times worth checking.
editor.loadError: Couldn't load the prayer times for editing.
editor.conflictTitle: Someone else saved in the meantime
editor.conflictBody: The prayer times changed since you opened the editor. You can load the new copy and put your changes back on top of it (they stay unsaved so you can check them before saving), or drop them.

issue.unsafe: Contains characters that are not allowed
issue.size: Too large to save, shorten some notes and names

editor.leaveBody: If you leave now, the changes to the prayer times are lost.
editor.previewEmpty: No rows with a time to show yet.
editor.previewNote: The row being edited is outlined on the sheet. Members only see what is saved.
editor.tooLong: The sheet is longer than one page. You can hide rows for this week.
editor.conflictMerged: The new copy is loaded and your changes were put back on top. Check them before saving.

phone.banner: Editing is on the web only.
phone.title: Please open on a computer
phone.body: The seat map is pasted and edited on a computer. On a phone you can only read.

start.title: The synagogue seat map
start.lead: Paste the table you already have. Nothing is saved or linked until you confirm.

step.one: Open the sheet (Google Sheets or Excel) on the map tab.
step.two: Select the whole tab: Ctrl+A (⌘+A on a Mac), then copy: Ctrl+C.
step.three: Come back here and paste: Ctrl+V.

start.mapTab: Paste the map tab, not the Form responses tab.
start.targetHelp: Titles, row numbers and empty cells do not matter. We find the seats.
start.grammar: A cell reads as: "Family-1" or "Family S.-2" = a seat of that family · "פנוי" = a seat with no family · "בימה" = the bimah · empty = aisle or wall.
start.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved and no family is linked until you confirm.
start.fallback: Or paste text into the box (no merged cells)
start.privacy: Family names on the map are visible to gabbaim and techs only. A member sees only his own block, two rows each way, with no names.

problem.too-large: The paste is too large: up to 40 rows and 60 columns. This is probably not the map.
problem.no-seats: No seats found. {rows} rows and {cols} columns were pasted, and none has a cell like "Family-1" or "פנוי".
problem.responses-tab: This looks like the Form responses tab, not the map. Responses are uploaded separately, as a responses file.
problem.hint: Make sure the whole map tab was copied, not just part of the table.

warn.two-names: Two names in one cell: "{raw}". You choose whose seat it is in the next step.
warn.duplicate-order: "{family}": the same number twice. A duplicated cell?
warn.order-gap: "{family}": a number is missing in the order. A missing seat?
warn.bimah-unsized: The bimah came as one cell and its size is unknown. It can be enlarged in structure mode.
warn.bimah-multiple: Several separate bimah areas were found.

check.lead: This is how the paste was read. This is how the hall will look.
check.hover: Hover or Tab onto a seat to see its original cell:
check.arkNote: The ark is not in the sheet. We put it at the front, above the first row, in the middle. It can be moved later.
check.spans: {n} households sit in more than one block (fine).
check.blockHelp: Right to left, as you stand facing the ark.

blockIssue.too-many: More than {max} blocks. The empty columns are probably part of the map: check the paste.

match.lead: Every name in the sheet must belong to a household of the Kehila: a family registered in the app, or a holder without an account that you create here. Nothing is linked without your confirmation.
match.bulk: {n} names match exactly one registered family (surname and first initial). Go through the list and confirm them together.
match.ambiguous: Several families fit equally: choose one.
match.optNew: New seat holder without an account
match.noneFound: No family in the app has this name.
match.sibling: There is also "{name}". If it is the same family, choose the same family for both.
match.twoNamesHelp: A seat belongs to one family.
match.litHelp: This name's seats are marked. Use it to check it is the right family.
match.pickRow: Pick a row to see its seats on the map.

save.title: Save the map
save.newHolders: {n} new holders without an account will be created.
save.noNewHolders: No new holders will be created.
save.fromHelp: Default: the first Shabbat not yet open for release. Past Shabbatot do not change.
save.replaces: A map taking effect on this Shabbat is already saved. Saving replaces it.
save.notReady: Decide every two-names cell before saving.
save.conflictTitle: Someone saved after you opened the editor
save.conflictLayout: A newer version of the map was saved. Saving now overwrites it.
save.conflictAssign: The assignments changed after you opened the editor. Saving now overwrites them.
save.overwriteSure: Sure? What is saved now will be replaced by the map you pasted.
save.done: The map is saved: {seats} seats, {holders} new holders.
save.doneHelp: Nothing is linked to an account without your confirmation.
save.replacesEarlier: The map in effect from this Shabbat has {assigned} of {seats} seats assigned. Saving rewrites the whole map and every assignment; an assignment not in the paste is erased.
save.openTitle: This Shabbat is already open for answers
save.openBody: You can save, but members who already answered will see on their seat page: "Your seats were updated by the gabbaim". Their counts move to the new seats in order.
save.partialBody: Some writes are already done. Retry (what was created is reused), or discard this partial state. Until then the date and Back are locked.

band.note: Another version of the map takes effect from {later}. What you change here applies until then and does not carry over to it.

holder.me: This is me: link to my family
holder.dirty: Save or discard your map changes before linking or deleting.
holder.deleteBody: Its seats become free, then the record is deleted:
holder.deleteLineOne: One seat in the version from {from}
holder.deleteNone: It holds no seat in any version of the map.
holder.deleteAfter: It leaves the families list and the link suggestions. This cannot be undone.
holder.linkPick: Pick the registered family. Its seats move there in every version, and the "no account" record closes.

start.scratchHelp: The Kehila has no map yet. Start from an empty grid and draw the hall.

panel.pick: Pick a family from the list, or click a seat on the map: you can assign it or mark it free.

picker.title: Assign the seats
picker.newHolder: New seat holder without an account
picker.name: Name (e.g. the Example family)
picker.badPhone: That phone number is not valid.

others.title: {name}'s seat
others.body: This seat belongs to another household. No seat changes hands without your choice.
others.bodyMany: {n} of the selected seats belong to other households: {names}. No seat changes hands without your choice.

move.taken: A seat of another household cannot be picked.

layout.hint: Select cells on the map, then a cell type. Keys: S seat, A aisle, B bimah, K ark, Delete empty.
layout.last: At least one row and one column must stay.
layout.pickCell: Pick a cell to remove its row or column.
layout.warn: {n} of the selected cells are taken. {names} will lose a seat. Continue?

save.title: Save the map
save.fromHelp: Past Shabbatot stay as they were.
save.replaces: A map already takes effect on this Shabbat, and it is not the one you opened. Saving replaces it.
save.openTitle: This Shabbat is already open for answers
save.openBody: You can save, but families that already answered will see that their seats were updated. Their counts move to the new seats in order.
save.newHolders: {n} new seat holders without an account will be created.
save.blockName: A block name is empty or too long.
save.rowLabel: A row name is too long (up to 8 characters).
save.shift: Adding or removing a row or column moves seats. Weekly answers for seats that moved are reset.

conflict.title: A newer version exists
conflict.body: Another gabbai saved the map at {time}, after you opened it.
conflict.bodyNoTime: Another gabbai saved the map after you opened it.
conflict.apply: Apply my changes to the new version
conflict.sure: Are you sure? The newer version will be replaced by what is in the editor now.
conflict.applied: Your changes were applied to the newer version. They are not saved yet.
conflict.appliedOverlap: Your changes were applied to the newer version and are not saved yet. {n} overlapping places stayed as in the newer version.
conflict.failed: Could not read the newer version.
conflict.gone: You removed this seat, so their assignment to it will not be kept.
conflict.family: The household got new seats from both sides

phone.banner: The map is edited on the website only.
phone.hint: You can see the hall and the list of families. Names appear when zoomed in.

seatUpload.title: Upload a responses file
seatUpload.lead: The file is the responses tab of the old Form. Only this week's answers are read, and each household's latest answer wins.
seatUpload.how: In Google Sheets, download the Form's responses tab (File > Download > CSV) and upload it here. The whole tab is fine: only this week's answers are read.
seatUpload.pickHelp: CSV or Excel. The file is read in the browser, and nothing is sent until you confirm.
seatUpload.templateHelp: The same columns as the Form
seatUpload.headersHelp: The Form's headers are longer; they are recognised by their words (ערב שבת, יום שבת, חג, מגילה, נשים, גברים, אולם), not by position.
seatUpload.pasteHint: Copy the whole tab from the sheet, including the header row.
seatUpload.privacy: The file is read in the browser. Only numbers per household are sent, after you confirm. Names from the file are not stored.
seatUpload.webOnly: Responses upload: on the website only.
seatUpload.earlier: A responses file was already uploaded for this Shabbat.

problem.no-timestamp: No timestamp column found. Is this the Form's responses tab?
problem.no-counts: No Shabbat evening or Shabbat day column found.
problem.big: The file is too big (2 MB at most).
problem.read: We could not read the file.

columns.title: Columns
columns.lead: We recognised the columns by their headers. Check that everything is right.

seatUpload.released: The Form asks how many seats are not needed. This is the released count, not the number coming.

window.main: {n} rows from this week (after last week's deadline). {old} older rows were not read.
window.undated: {n} rows without a readable date were not read.
window.unreadable: {n} cells that are not numbers were left out.
window.none: The file has no answers from this week.

match.lead: Every name in the file needs a household: a registered family, or a seat holder without an account. Nothing is matched without you.
match.noSeats: has no seats on the map
match.optSkipHelp: This answer will not be applied.
match.requestOnly: A row that releases seats needs a household that holds seats. A request-only row is saved only for a household that has seats on the map.

preview.summary: {change} households will change ({noAccount} without an account) · {same} unchanged · {skipped} skipped · {errors} errors
preview.undoFirst: A file was already uploaded for this Shabbat. Applying undoes it first, then applies this one.
preview.noSeats: It has no seats on the map this week, so there is nothing to release.
preview.duplicate: There is a later answer for the same household.
preview.keptHelp: By default the app's answer wins. You can pick the file for any household.
preview.requestsNote: Counted for the requests list (no map, numbers only). They do not change the men's map.
preview.orderNote: A release applies to the family's seats in its own order, as in the sheet. By default the app's answer wins.

result.undoneSkipped: Upload undone. {n} seats changed since stay as they are.
result.undoHelp: Undo restores the households the file changed (also those without an account) and removes the requests it added. A seat changed since, in the app or by a gabbai, stays as it is.

warn.app_answer_kept: {n} households answered in the app and their answer stayed
warn.no_seats: {n} households have no seats on the map and were not applied
warn.above_seats: {n} households asked to release more than they hold, so all their seats were released

empty.title: No hall map saved yet
empty.body: To upload answers you first need a hall map with families. Paste or draw it in the map editor.

seatHolders.title: Seat holders without an account
seatHolders.lead: Families who sit in the synagogue and have no account. A gabbai created them (by paste, by hand or from a responses file). They appear on the map and can be updated on their behalf; when they register, you link them.
seatHolders.empty: No seat holders without an account.
seatHolders.privacy: Personal data: only gabbaim and techs see it; deleted on request; never in notifications or logs.

card.hints: {n} link suggestions: families who registered and look like seat holders.

suggest.lead: Families who registered in the app and look like seat holders here.

form.name: Household name
form.phoneHelp: Helps suggest a link when they register.
form.badPhone: The phone number is not valid.
form.privacy: After saving, choose its seats on the map. Personal data: only gabbaim and techs see it; deleted on request; never in notifications or logs.

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.body: The record is deleted and its {n} seats go back to free in every version of the map. This cannot be undone. It also serves a family's deletion request.

link.title: Link "{name}"
link.what1: The seats move to {household}, from today (also this coming Shabbat).
link.what2: Answers a gabbai or the file already gave for them stay.
link.what4: The head of the household gets a "Your seats in the synagogue" card on Home and can release seats in the app.
link.union: {household} already hold {family} seats. After linking they will have {total}. If this is a double entry in the sheet, free a seat afterwards on the map.
link.never: Only one unmistakable match is linked by itself, when a member is approved (it then shows above, with an undo). "Not the same family" hides this suggestion on this device; you can still link by hand.
link.changed: The record changed in the meantime. The list was refreshed; check and try again.
link.retry: The link did not complete. The record is kept. Try again.
link.gone: The record or the family was not found. The list was refreshed.

auto.title: Linked automatically
auto.item: Linked automatically: the {family} family ← seat holder {holder}
auto.undone: Link undone. The seat holder is back.
auto.undonePartly: Link undone. {n} seats changed meanwhile were left as they are.
auto.pending: The link stopped half-way. You can finish it.

approval.maybe: Could this be one from the map:
approval.after: The suggestion also appears after approval, in the seat holders list, where you link. Nothing is linked by itself.

tree.title: Family tree

legend.tap: Tap a person to open their details

tree.noSiblings: Siblings aren't recorded. Only people whose names your names need.
tree.startBody: Tap a person and fill in the Hebrew name. A father's name passes to the children, building the aliyah name.
tree.privacy: You, {partner} and the Kehila's gabbaim and techs see the tree and details.
tree.privacyAlone: You and the Kehila's gabbaim and techs see the tree and details.
tree.readOnly: Read only. You can see the tree but not change it.

list.empty: No one is in the tree yet.

link.title: Add {role}
link.memberM: My husband is a Kehila member
link.memberF: My wife is a Kehila member
link.memberHint: Pick them from the member list and send a request. The link is made only after they confirm.
link.manual: Fill in details without an account
link.manualHint: No account is linked. You fill in the name and details yourself.
link.invite: Invite them to link their account
link.inviteHint: Is your partner a Kehila member? Send a request to link their account; these details are then merged.
link.bannerNote: If you do not confirm, {name} will only see that the request was not confirmed.

mine.title: My details in the Kehila
mine.switchOn: Members, gabbaim and techs of {kehila} can see it.
mine.switchOff: Only the gabbaim and techs of {kehila} can see it.
mine.invalid: Check "My details in the Kehila": a field needs fixing.
mine.doneBefore: What was saved before it stays.
mine.treeFailed: My details were saved, but the tree was not: {why}

ill.button: Mark as ill · for a full recovery
ill.confirm: Mark {name} as ill? The name will appear in the Mi Sheberach for the sick.
ill.caption: For a full recovery
ill.nameTitle: Mi Sheberach name for the sick
ill.toGabbai: The name will be sent to the gabbai for the Mi Sheberach (coming soon)

dec.confirm: Mark {name} as deceased? A memorial candle and ז״ל will appear, and the date-of-death fields open.
dec.caption: Deceased · {hdate}

f.firstHint: As called to the Torah. Two names? Write both.
f.fillsFather: Also saved on the father in the tree.
f.fillsMother: Also saved on the mother in the tree.
f.fromFather: Taken from the father when this person was added. You can change it.
f.gregBad: Not a valid Gregorian date. For example 2.12.2028
f.adarNote: A leap year has two Adars; we keep exactly which one.

err.partialDate: Fill in the day and month, or leave the date empty.
err.future: The date can't be in the future.
err.deathBeforeBirth: Date of death is before date of birth.
err.yearRange: The Hebrew year is out of range (5000 to 6000).

tree.feedWarnFather: This is also the father's name of {n} children. Their names will update when you save.
tree.feedWarnFatherOne: This is also the father's name of the child. Their name will update when you save.
tree.feedWarnMother: This is also the mother's name of {n} children. Their names will update when you save.
tree.feedWarnMotherOne: This is also the mother's name of the child. Their name will update when you save.
tree.marriedAfter: After saving you can add a spouse and children.
tree.grandkidsNote: Grandchildren have a name, son/daughter and birth date. The tree stops there.
tree.remove: Remove {name} from the tree? It's removed for {partner} too.
tree.clearAsk: Clear the details of {name}? The figure stays on the tree.

bm.title: Bar mitzvah
bm.why: Suggested: the Shabbat of or after the 13th Hebrew birthday. Families sometimes move it; you can change it.
bm.weekday: That's a {day} ({hdate}), not Shabbat. That week's Shabbat: {shabbat}. Set it?
bm.afterBirthDate: After the birth date, a bar mitzvah Shabbat is suggested.
bm.note: Pick any date; if it isn't a Shabbat, we offer that week's Shabbat.
bm.keepAsk: The birth date changed. Your chosen Shabbat was kept. The new suggestion: {shabbat}.

batm.title: Bat mitzvah
batm.note: A bat mitzvah has no Shabbat on the tree. The date is information only.

fig.title: My figure
fig.grows: The figure grows by itself with the birth date. You can choose skin, hair and glasses.

tree.conflictNotSaved: Your change was NOT saved: somebody else updated the tree. The tree was reloaded. Check the details and save again.

simchas.title: Upcoming simchas
simchas.intro: Bar and bat mitzvahs in the next 8 weeks, from family trees.
simchas.none: No bar or bat mitzvahs in the next 8 weeks.
simchas.noneNote: The list is built from the birth dates in family trees. A family without a date does not appear.
simchas.toSheet: Add to mazal tov in the weekly sheet
simchas.toSheetNote: Mazal tov messages appear in the weekly sheet. Each simcha is sent on its own, to its own family.
simchas.privacy: Only first name, surname and date. Gabbaim and techs only.
simchas.suggestedNote: Suggested date: check with the family

mazal.blessingHint: Suggested for this occasion. Change or delete it.

parents.plain: On the birth of a son
